source_basis: VIBE paper section 3.1 clip-shared shape, released code discrepancy retained
input: Existing unchanged FlowMesh global_condition B,T,64; explicit upstream admissible bool mask B,T; strictly increasing per-stream frame IDs and explicit sequence IDs
control: Same frozen/random FlowMesh encoder/shape head, first-frame shape_head(global_condition[:,0]) on a fixture whose first frame is admissible
candidate: Mean of first 8 admissible prefix features using same shape_head; beta unavailable (NaN plus ready=False) before eighth admissible frame; one shared beta thereafter
single_variable: Shape calibration readout: first-frame versus masked prefix; pose generator, graph/history, weights, random seed, SMPL-H assets, sampling budget unchanged
evidence_eligibility: Supplied explicitly by caller; does not infer quality from network confidence or change strict geometry gates. Admissible requires caller-provided finite evidence; number of frames is an engineering threshold, not shape observability proof
stream_contract: State bound to sequence IDs and batch rows; duplicate/reordered IDs rejected; no future features influence published beta; missing frames not counted; no output or retroactive patch for unready frames
success: future perturbation cannot change already released beta
missing/nonfinite masked frames excluded; all missing remains unavailable
different sequences/batch rows never share state
no baseline parameter change or new learned layer
real SMPL-H decode finite and finite nonzero shape/feature gradient for ready segment
failure_stop: Nonfinite admissible features, sequence/frame-order mismatch, illegal rotation or asset mismatch fail explicitly; do not replace missing beta with zero/default
boundary: Structural architecture improvement only; beta accuracy, real imagery, independent 3D precision and realtime latency untested
